name: truncate-tooltip
title: Truncate tooltip
description: Text that ends in an ellipsis and shows the full text in a tooltip only when it is actually cut off, by hover, keyboard focus or a tap.
docs: Give it a width to work in: a flex child with min-w-0, a table cell in a fixed layout, or a box with a maximum width. lines sets a clamp to that many lines. It measures after layout, on resize and when web fonts arrive, and only a cut-off text gets the tooltip and a tab stop, so a table of names adds no tab stop to rows that fit. The text stays whole in the DOM, so screen readers and copy get all of it. On touch a tap toggles the tooltip.
